name: legispect/wordpress
description: A Wordpress project that uses composer for PHP package management. It aims to provide a observable, quick-to-deploy, easy to configure, environment-agnostic Wordpress project.

test:plugins: bash -c 'set -e; shopt -s nullglob; for dir in custom-plugins/*/ custom-themes/*/; do if [ -f "${dir}phpunit.xml.dist" ]; then echo "==> Testing ${dir}"; composer --working-dir="$dir" test; fi; done'
test:plugin: bash -c 'TARGET="$1"; shift || true; if [ -d "custom-plugins/${TARGET}" ]; then DIR="custom-plugins/${TARGET}"; elif [ -d "custom-themes/${TARGET}" ]; then DIR="custom-themes/${TARGET}"; elif [ -d "${TARGET}" ]; then DIR="${TARGET}"; else echo "Unknown plugin/theme: ${TARGET}" >&2; exit 1; fi; composer --working-dir="$DIR" test -- "$@"' --
test:container: docker run --rm -e OTEL_PHP_DISABLED_INSTRUMENTATIONS=all -v $(pwd):/workspace:z -w /workspace mirror.gcr.io/library/php:8.5.12-cli php vendor/bin/phpunit || docker run --rm -e OTEL_PHP_DISABLED_INSTRUMENTATIONS=all -v $(pwd):/workspace -w /workspace mirror.gcr.io/library/php:8.5.12-cli php vendor/bin/phpunit
test:plugins:container: docker run --rm -e OTEL_PHP_DISABLED_INSTRUMENTATIONS=all -v $(pwd):/workspace:z -w /workspace mirror.gcr.io/library/php:8.5.12-cli sh -c 'set -e; for dir in custom-plugins/*/ custom-themes/*/; do if [ -f "${dir}phpunit.xml.dist" ]; then echo "==> Testing ${dir}"; (cd "$dir" && php /workspace/vendor/bin/phpunit); fi; done' || docker run --rm -e OTEL_PHP_DISABLED_INSTRUMENTATIONS=all -v $(pwd):/workspace -w /workspace mirror.gcr.io/library/php:8.5.12-cli sh -c 'set -e; for dir in custom-plugins/*/ custom-themes/*/; do if [ -f "${dir}phpunit.xml.dist" ]; then echo "==> Testing ${dir}"; (cd "$dir" && php /workspace/vendor/bin/phpunit); fi; done'
test:plugin:container: bash -c 'TARGET="$1"; shift || true; if [ -d "custom-plugins/${TARGET}" ]; then DIR="custom-plugins/${TARGET}"; elif [ -d "custom-themes/${TARGET}" ]; then DIR="custom-themes/${TARGET}"; elif [ -d "${TARGET}" ]; then DIR="${TARGET}"; else echo "Unknown plugin/theme: ${TARGET}" >&2; exit 1; fi; composer --working-dir="$DIR" test:container -- "$@"' --
test:plugins:sapi: bash -c 'set -e; shopt -s nullglob; for dir in custom-plugins/*/ custom-themes/*/; do if [ -f "${dir}phpunit.sapi.xml.dist" ]; then echo "==> SAPI Testing ${dir}"; composer --working-dir="$dir" test:sapi; fi; done'
test:plugins:sapi:container: docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/workspace:z -w /workspace mirror.gcr.io/library/php:8.5.12-fpm-alpine sh -c 'set -e; apk add --no-cache nginx bash >/dev/null; for dir in custom-plugins/*/ custom-themes/*/; do if [ -f "${dir}phpunit.sapi.xml.dist" ]; then echo "==> SAPI Testing ${dir}"; (cd "$dir" && bash bin/test-sapi.sh); fi; done' || docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/workspace -w /workspace mirror.gcr.io/library/php:8.5.12-fpm-alpine sh -c 'set -e; apk add --no-cache nginx bash >/dev/null; for dir in custom-plugins/*/ custom-themes/*/; do if [ -f "${dir}phpunit.sapi.xml.dist" ]; then echo "==> SAPI Testing ${dir}"; (cd "$dir" && bash bin/test-sapi.sh); fi; done'
test:plugin:sapi: bash -c 'TARGET="$1"; shift || true; if [ -d "custom-plugins/${TARGET}" ]; then DIR="custom-plugins/${TARGET}"; elif [ -d "custom-themes/${TARGET}" ]; then DIR="custom-themes/${TARGET}"; elif [ -d "${TARGET}" ]; then DIR="${TARGET}"; else echo "Unknown plugin/theme: ${TARGET}" >&2; exit 1; fi; composer --working-dir="$DIR" test:sapi -- "$@"' --
test:plugin:sapi:container: bash -c 'TARGET="$1"; shift || true; if [ -d "custom-plugins/${TARGET}" ]; then DIR="custom-plugins/${TARGET}"; elif [ -d "custom-themes/${TARGET}" ]; then DIR="custom-themes/${TARGET}"; elif [ -d "${TARGET}" ]; then DIR="${TARGET}"; else echo "Unknown plugin/theme: ${TARGET}" >&2; exit 1; fi; composer --working-dir="$DIR" test:sapi:container -- "$@"' --
lint:container: docker run --rm -e OTEL_PHP_DISABLED_INSTRUMENTATIONS=all -v $(pwd):/workspace:z -w /workspace mirror.gcr.io/library/php:8.5.12-cli php vendor/bin/pint --test || docker run --rm -e OTEL_PHP_DISABLED_INSTRUMENTATIONS=all -v $(pwd):/workspace -w /workspace mirror.gcr.io/library/php:8.5.12-cli php vendor/bin/pint --test
lint:fix:container: docker run --rm -e OTEL_PHP_DISABLED_INSTRUMENTATIONS=all -v $(pwd):/workspace:z -w /workspace mirror.gcr.io/library/php:8.5.12-cli php vendor/bin/pint || docker run --rm -e OTEL_PHP_DISABLED_INSTRUMENTATIONS=all -v $(pwd):/workspace -w /workspace mirror.gcr.io/library/php:8.5.12-cli php vendor/bin/pint
docker-build: docker buildx build -f deployment/php-fpm.Dockerfile --target app -t localhost/wordpress-test .
docker-compose:up: docker compose -f deployment/docker-compose.yaml up --build || podman-compose -f deployment/docker-compose.yaml up --build
docker-compose:down: docker compose -f deployment/docker-compose.yaml down || podman-compose -f deployment/docker-compose.yaml down
